commands.title: Turn On (Register with Claude Code and Codex)
Turn Off (Unregister from Claude Code and Codex)

enumDescriptions: Ask once before adding the "copane" MCP server to Claude Code's and Codex's user configuration. Afterwards Copane keeps its own entry present and up to date (it re-adds it if something removes it) until you run "Copane: Turn Off".
Add and keep the "copane" MCP server in Claude Code's and Codex's user configuration without asking.
Never change agent configuration on its own; only report problems. Use "Copane: Turn On", "Copane: Turn Off" and "Copane: Check and Repair Setup".
copane.registration.mode.markdownDescription: How Copane makes its tools available to agents. It adds an MCP server named `copane` to the user configuration of Claude Code (`~/.claude.json`) and Codex (`~/.codex/config.toml`), and never changes or removes a `copane` server it did not add.

copane.registration.claudeCode.markdownDescription: Register the `copane` MCP server with Claude Code (the `claude` CLI and the Claude Code VS Code extension).

copane.registration.codex.markdownDescription: Register the `copane` MCP server with Codex, when Codex is installed.
